segments.contextAfter: `leftTeam`: The sports team that should appear on the left side of the now playing screen. This is commonly (but not always) the AWAY or VISITING team. This team will be on the left in all layouts; it does not flip to the right side when in a right-to-left language or a right-hand-drive vehicle.
